beats.headline: Off a dead crawler's fingers
beats.text: Of the three dead women left out as a trap, the human named Nica still has two rings on her fingers, both +2 to strength. Donut can't wear them, so Carl rubs the blood off and puts them on himself, which makes four rings and brings his strength back to an acceptable level. He takes no joy in looting the corpses of fellow crawlers. All the same, he can see the allure of being a player killer. This game gives a lot of loot.

beats.headline: Best not mentioned
beats.text: In the crowd outside the fallen municipal building, Carl recognises a crawler he takes for family of Grace, Nica and Lea, the three dead women they came across several days earlier. Someone with them had looted most of their gear. Donut picked up the anklet, and Carl took the two generic strength rings. If the man knew they had them, would he want them back? That would be too bad for him. Carl figures it is best not to broach the subject at all.
